TC-CHECKOUT-005.objective: Does double-clicking the actual order-creating control (Payment page's "Pay and Confirm Order" button) create a duplicate order, checked at the network level rather than only via end-state UI
TC-CHECKOUT-005.note: Deviated from testing "Place Order" literally: that control is a plain navigation link (<a href="/payment">), not a submit action, so it cannot itself create a duplicate order. The real order-creating step is the Payment page's data-qa="pay-button", inside a <form method="POST" action="/payment"> - tested here instead.
